name: Federal Republic of Central America
description: A horizontal triband of light blue, white and light blue charged at the centre with the federation's arms: five volcanoes between the seas beneath a rainbow and cap of liberty.
history: Flag of the Federal Republic of Central America (1823–1841), whose blue-white-blue lives on in the flags of Guatemala, Honduras, El Salvador, Nicaragua and Costa Rica.

features.role: five volcanoes, rainbow and Phrygian cap
features.symbolism: the five member states between two oceans
